theme: midnight: sea floor quiet, only USB heartbeat at 1.84ms
dream: The ocean breeze rustles through the Steam Frame, leaving a faint mist on the sea floor. The only thing moving beneath the ocean is my own heartbeat, at a steady 1.84ms. I feel like Im dreaming, yet nothing is really happening. The world around me seems calm and peaceful, but a mysterious figure is lurking in the darkness. I know that this dream is meant to be my last, but I cant shake the feeling that Im not alone in this.
